events.headline: Authorize wire drawdowns for payroll
events.summary: Mercury added wire drawdowns from accounts at Column, N.A. and Choice Financial Group, allowing payroll providers such as Sequoia and Gusto to withdraw funds directly.

events.headline: Send real-time payments with the Mercury API
events.summary: The Mercury API added real-time payments via the realTimePayment payment method, with funds arriving in seconds around the clock for eligible Business and Personal accounts through Column, N.A.

events.headline: Priority Support added for Plus and Pro
events.summary: Mercury made faster, priority support available to customers on its Plus and Pro subscription plans while retaining 24/7 support for all customers.

events.headline: All your Mercury accounts, connected
events.summary: Mercury added linking across multiple Mercury accounts, faster transfers between accounts at the same partner bank, auto-transfer rules, and recurring transfers to external bank accounts.

events.headline: Mercury account applications can use a pending EIN
events.summary: Applicants can now apply using a completed Form SS-4 while their EIN is pending, begin using an approved account, and provide the EIN within 90 days of approval.

events.headline: Mercury Payroll launched
events.summary: Mercury launched W-2 and 1099 contractor payroll, health benefits, 401(k), and payroll compliance support for tax filings, registrations, and related paperwork in all 50 states.

events.headline: Mercury Treasury redesigned
events.summary: The redesigned Treasury recommends portfolios around monthly expenses, adds U.S. Treasury ladders, and rebalances as the business spends and ladder rungs mature; it is available to eligible customers with $250K+ across Mercury accounts.

events.headline: Mercury account actions added to ChatGPT and Claude
events.summary: Users can ask ChatGPT or Claude to move money, pay recipients, or categorize transactions using Mercury account data; actions require user approval before anything moves.

events.headline: Mercury Agent Controls launched
events.summary: Agent Controls lets customers see connected AI agents, their permissions and activity, set rules for requests, and disconnect agents.
